description: Active sport adapters — the pluggable list. Adding a sport = add an adapter module and list it here; the engine auto-registers it. Development lock: the UI exposes only Tennis and Football; expansion into other sports is locked until the Tennis module is fully stabilized and verified with prediction accuracy exceeding 80%.

development_lock.rule: No new sport may be exposed until the Tennis module is fully stabilized and verified with prediction accuracy exceeding 80%.
